show.title: Soulection All Day 2019
show.content:

A day of exclusive mixes from [Jaël](/episodes/all-day-2019/#ja%C3%ABl-set), [Sharnie](/episodes/all-day-2019/#sharnies-set), and [Shaka Lion](/episodes/all-day-2019/#shaka-lions-set).
